claims: 'the rich, stubborn, obsessive Yash Sabharwal (Sunil Shetty) for whom life is a business'; 'love at first sight for him'; Yash sponsors Isha's studies and hires Gaurav 'to woo Isha and then dump her'; 'Sunil Shetty has a miniscule role'; 'Despite a confusingly sketched role, Sunil lends it some dignity'.

title: The Rediff Review: Ittefaq
claims: Ex-cop-turned-henchman Shiva is called in to locate the witness; 'Finally, Shetty turns over a new leaf and helps make a hero of Vikram'; Shetty is 'totally wasted'; Pooja Batra and Anupama Verma 'are seen only during the song and dance sequences'.

title: Ittefaq Review
claims: Rated 1/5. The criminal appoints 'a killer (Sunil Shetty) to nab the young man'; 'the flashback of Sunil Shetty is far from convincing'; 'Sunil Shetty leaves a mark in action scenes only'.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: The Yeh Teraa Ghar, Yeh Meraa Ghar Review
claims: Dayashankar Manorilal (Sunil Shetty) is 'a village simpleton, clutching his umbrella and file for dear life', who 'spouts legalese at the drop of a hat'.
notes: Only the first slide of a slide-show review was captured (about 640 characters of text).

title: The Rediff Review -- Ehsaas
claims: Ravi Naik, a poor widowed government employee, drives his 11-year-old son through a training routine unacceptable to the boy and to the neighbour Antara, a young widow; 'In the course of the film, Ravi and Antra fall in love'; Shetty 'as the strict father who finds it hard to express his love to his son is average'; 'Neha looks perpetually confused and hurt'.

title: Ehsaas - A Feeling Review
claims: Rated 2/5. The father is 'shown in a negative light in the entire first half'; his ill-treatment of his son 'makes you feel as if the child were his step-son'; Antra is Rohan's best friend and soulmate.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Officer Review
claims: Rated 1/5. Sagar shadows Meenal and rescues her from suicide; 'Meenal's fondness for Sagar develops in love'; 'Sagar is shocked when she proposes to him. He is unable to take a decision'; she commits suicide; in Goa he meets her lookalike Pari, who 'proves her identity', while Pratap Rai insists she is his wife; 'Raveena Tandon gives a decent account of herself'.
author: Taran Adarsh
notes: The page's datePublished reads 2 February 2001, a month before the film's release, so it is treated as a site migration artefact and only the year is recorded.

title: Awara Paagal Deewana Review
claims: Rated 2/5. Yeda Anna (Sunil Shetty) and Chhota Chhatri are contract killers; 'Sunil Shetty's introduction (action) is nail-biting'; the interval point 'when Akshay and Sunil join hands' surprises; 'The wife swapping - Aftab's wife Amrita Arora teaming with Sunil Shetty... is difficult to absorb'; the climax has 'the two heroes (Akshay, Sunil) coming to blows'.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: The Rediff Review: Jaani Dushman
claims: The college friends, among them Sunil Shetty, 'plan a picnic with their respective girlfriends'; 'Sunil Shetty maintains a stoic face throughout the film.'

title: On the sets of Anarth
claims: Set report: the film has 'another family... two brothers --- Sunil Shetty and Ashutosh Rana --- and a sister (Preeti Jhangiani)'; cricketer Vinod Kambli debuts as Sunil's friend; the 'lead pair' is Sanjay Dutt and Shweta Menon.

title: The Rediff Review: Karz-The Burden of Truth
claims: 'Suniel Shetty doesn't convince as a roving-eyed Romeo'; despite promos suggesting 'a love triangle between two brothers and their common dream girl --- Shilpa Shetty, the film is about an abandoned boy yearning for his mother's affections'; Shilpa Shetty 'sizzles in a brief role'.

title: Karz - The Burden of Truth Review
claims: Rated 1.5/5. Sapna, the daughter of his father's friend, lives with Sooraj, who loves her silently; Raja 'is in search of his dream woman' and falls for Sapna, insisting 'his intentions are honourable and that he intends marrying' her; his mother is Sitara Devi; 'The romance between Sunil and Shilpa also seems half-baked and underdeveloped. How and why does Shilpa suddenly start reciprocating Sunil's feelings are just not explained.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Maseeha Review
claims: Rated 1/5. Krishna, a victim of Surajbhan's atrocities, returns from jail and frees Shantinagar; 'Sunil's role lacks substance'; 'Sunil Shetty seems to be repeating himself'.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Kaante Review
claims: Rated 3.5/5. 'Sunil Shetty is superb, conveying a lot through his expressions'; the Dutt-Shetty fight over the loot is well executed.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Film Review: 12 B
claims: 'Sunil Shetty makes a bow in the Tamil tinsel town. A brief role, but well done'; praises 'the scene in which Arvind (Sunil Shetty) comes face to face with Jyotika's lover Shaktivel'.

title: Khanjar (The Knife) (2003)
claims: Release date 27 June 2003 (India); runtime 2 h 7 min; cast Tabu (Shilpa), Suniel Shetty (Raja), Gulshan Grover, Mohan Joshi, Pankaj Dheer, Shiva Rindani, Laxmikant Berde, Archana Puran Singh; overview: 'Chander Sharma's son is in love with Shilpa (Tabu) and his rival is Raja (Sunil Shetty), who also becomes embroiled in the mystery.'
notes: Community-edited; the only located source for the release date, runtime, his character's function and the romance premise. Used because no stronger source was found.

title: Baaz: a thriller without attitude
claims: 'Harshvardhan (Suniel Shetty) is the local police officer with a penchant for stalking the victims he is meant to protect'; Shetty 'comes across as terribly miscast towards the end'; 'The biggest letdown is Suniel Shetty.'

title: Hot babes, hotter action
claims: Akram Sheikh is 'the patriotic chief of the Indian commandos' who turns to Rachit for help; credits list Raveena Tandon in a special appearance; 'The Ajay Devgan-Neha Dhupia love story is out of place.'
author: Priya Ganapati

title: Qayamat Review
claims: Rated 2/5. Akram, a CBI officer, plans the operation; 'Suniel Shetty is first-rate.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: The game that never began
claims: Dev Mallya 'is a rich businessman who operates more like an underworld don'; both he and Rohan love Saanjh, who 'is oblivious to Dev's feelings; she loves Rohan'; Dev buys the police officer and both lawyers and 'gets Rohan sentenced to life imprisonment in just two hearings'; Shetty 'repeats his award-winning negative act (including the name Dev)' from Dhadkan and 'delivers the best performance in the film'; Celina Jaitley 'does little to emote'.

title: Khel Review
claims: Rated 2/5. 'a love triangle and a thriller rolled into one'; after Rohan's conviction 'Dev and Saanjh, while sharing a common grief, become close friends'; the climax is 'at the engagement ceremony'; 'Suniel Shetty is excellent playing an anti-hero [after DHADKAN]'; Suhasini Mulay plays his grandmother.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Why we can never forget Kargil
claims: Suniel Shetty plays 'rifleman Sanjay Kumar', among actors who 'live up to the real life heroes'; the film 'also deals with the women who have to live their lives in constant fear for their loved ones'.
author: Anita Bora

title: Bipasha's failed experiment
claims: Bhura (Suniel Shetty) is 'a formidable character who gets to the powerful rudraksh first'; Lali (Ishaa Koppikar) is 'his sexy consort' who 'has nothing to do, except look good'.
author: Ronjita Kulkarni

title: Main Hoon Na Review
claims: Rated 4/5. Raghavan 'will do anything to prevent the strategic move'; in the climax 'Shetty overpowers SRK'; 'Suniel Shetty is fantastic as the terrorist.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Lakeer: Beyond the pale
claims: 'Suniel Shetty plays Sanju, the resident toughie-mechanic at Surajnagar'; 'Sunny and Suniel can't do justice with their badly etched characters.'
author: Vivek Fernandes

title: Lakeer Review
claims: Rated 2/5. 'Sanju [Suniel Shetty] is a motor mechanic, loved by all'; he thrashes Sohail Khan's Karan in the college, mistaking him for Apoorva Agnihotri's character; 'Suniel Shetty looks dashing in a new look and comes up with an equally convincing performance, although he really doesn't get the best of lines.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Lakeer - movie review by Abid
claims: Sanju, a motor mechanic, sends his brother Saahil to the same expensive school as Arjun's brother Karan and 'has aspirations of one day becoming rich and influential like Arjun'; he beats up Karan by mistake; 'Sunil Shetty is erratic, good in some parts and ordinary in others.'
author: Abid
notes: Fan-run review site; used only for role description alongside the Rediff and Bollywood Hungama reviews.

title: The great big testosterone overdrive!
claims: Shetty plays encounter specialist Appa Kadam Naik; Preeti Jhangiani (Janki, 'Sunil's onscreen police wife') and Lara Dutta 'have even less ornamental value'; 'Action heroes Akshay Kumar and Suniel Shetty live up to their sobriquets, turning in power-packed performances.'
author: Vivek Fernandes

title: Aan – Men at Work Review
claims: Rated 2/5. 'Inspector Appa Naik [Suniel Shetty], the encounter specialist, is of the opinion that criminals need to be eliminated'; 'Suniel delivers yet another performance that he can be proud of'; 'Preeti Jhangiani is adequate in a brief role.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Kyun! Ho Gaya Na Movie Review
claims: 'The presence of Suniel Shetty comes across as a twist in the tale'; 'Suniel Shetty is passable.' The chemistry between Vivek Oberoi and Aishwarya Rai 'is clearly lacking'.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Rakht chills in parts
claims: Plot outline with Drishti (Bipasha Basu) as a tarot reader; 'Where does Mohit (Suniel Shetty) fit in?'
author: Shilpa Bharatan-Iyer

title: Rakht Review
claims: Rated 2.5/5. 'Mohit [Suniel Shetty], a car mechanic, who has a soft corner for Drishti'; he is one of the suspects ('the eccentric mechanic'); 'the climax, when Suniel and Himanshu surface suddenly, looks convenient and unpersuasive'.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Jaane Bhi Do Yaaron, this one is not!
claims: Rahul (Suniel Shetty), a gardener's son, must become a gangster to inherit a Rs 400 crore property; Kanchan (Raveena Tandon) is a police inspector whose 'only dream is to nab a gangster'; 'Initially, Suniel and Raveena's comedy track falls flat as they clearly lack comic timing. Raveena improves towards the end.'
author: Patcy N

title: Ek Se Badhkar Ek Review
claims: Rated 1.5/5. Rahul's neighbour Kanchan, a police officer, 'aspires to nab the biggest don in the city'; 'After their initial scuffle, Rahul and Kanchan reach an understanding: Kanchan will get Rahul an entry into the world of crime', and he must give her underworld information; Rahul kidnaps the don Jindaal by mistake.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Hulchul: a painful watch
claims: Complains of 'the constant shrieking and hoarse/shrill (Suneil Shetty/Lakshmi) yelling'.
author: Raja Sen

title: Hulchul Review
claims: Rated 3/5. 'The film has a huge supporting cast, but Jackie Shroff and Suniel Shetty stand out of the lot.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Padmashree is an insult to cinema!
claims: Open letter to the director; Laloo (Suniel Shetty) is a 'Casanova employee' caught in bed with his uncle's mistress; objects to 'Suniel Shetty blowing kisses to Johnny Lever, and looking positively vulgar'; calls Shetty and most of the cast 'non-actors'.
author: Ronjita Kulkarni

title: Blackmail: Predictable, yet entertaining
claims: The film 'opens with ACP Abhay Singh Rathore (Suneil Shetty) marrying Sana (Priyanka Chopra)'; he 'returns to his loving family which now includes son Chirag'; Shekhar met 'his late wife, Anjali (Dia Mirza)' at a church; Priyanka 'has three tasks', one being to wail 'Chirag kahan hai'.
author: Shilpa Bharatan-Iyer

title: Blackmail (2005) review
claims: Borrows from Ransom; Abhay Rathod is 'a proud family man who takes his job very seriously'; 'as Abhay's wife Sana (Priyanka Chopra) discovers, there's more to the situation than first meets the eye'; 'Shetty and Devgan are spot on as respective cop and robber', while Chopra 'fails to convince as a plain housewife and concerned mother'.

title: Tango Charlie disappoints
claims: Praises Devgan and Deol; a viewer found 'the love stories of both the heroes' boring; Shetty is not assessed.
author: Harish Kotian

title: Tango Charlie (2005) review
claims: Two pilots (Sanjay Dutt and Suneil Shetty) rescue Tarun Chauhan from the snowy peaks of Kashmir and read his diary, which frames the story in flashback.

title: Paheli is a breathtaking dream
claims: 'Juhi Chawla firmly enters Bollywood sis-in-law mode'; Shetty's role is not assessed.
author: Raja Sen

title: Dus is full-on timepass
claims: 'Suniel Shetty could have totally been cut out of the film. Raima Sen plays his wife, an unimaginably irritating character, the perfect muse for homicide.'
author: Raja Sen

title: Dus Review
claims: Rated 2/5. Shetty is the local cop who chases the agents for rash driving and is injured by gunmen; 'Suniel wants to patch up with his wife Raima'; 'Only the Sanju-Shilpa love story appears convincing, otherwise the romantic sequences of the remaining three pair looks contrived'; 'Suniel Shetty is okay'; 'Dia Mirza and Raima Sen get minimal scope.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Review: Chocolate is worth a bite
claims: Tanushree Dutta plays 'a conniving sex goddess'; 'Suniel Shetty, whose role is pivotal to the plot, could have added much more value through his performance.'
author: Merril Diniz

title: Chocolate Review
claims: Rated 1.5/5. 'Rocker [Suniel Shetty] is an obsessed lover, wanting to marry Sim. Sim [Tanushree Dutta] is a temptress'; 'You actually start wondering what this girl is up to and is she really taking Rocker for a ride?'; 'Suniel Shetty puts in a sincere effort.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Chocolate (Deep Dark Secrets) (2005) review
claims: Pipi and Sim are arrested in London; Rocker (Suneil Shetty), Tubby and Devaa are their 'partners in crime'.

title: Will Salman save Kyon Ki?
claims: 'The romance between Salman and Kareena seems unconvincing.' Shetty's fiancé role is not discussed.
author: Patcy N

title: Deewane Hue Paagal: Good fun
claims: Tanya 'has a handicapped friend called Sanju (Suniel Shetty), who is actually a plumber but tells her he is an architect'; 'If Suniel Shetty could modulate his voice, he could be an okay actor.'
author: Patcy N

title: Deewane Huye Paagal (Lovers Gone Mad) (2005) review
claims: 'There's Something About Mary meets Mickey Blue Eyes'; Rocky 'has to join the queue behind Sanju (Suniel Shetty) and Tommy (Paresh Rawal), two of Tanya's physically disabled friends' who fancy her.

title: Home Delivery Review
claims: Rated 1/5. 'The topnotch stars [Abhishek Bachchan, Suniel Shetty, Naseeruddin Shah et al] that make a 10-15 second appearance also don't arouse curiosity.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Don't bother joining this Fight Club
claims: 'Suniel Shetty and Rahul Dev are fine. Neha Dhupia hardly has a role.'
author: Rujuta Paradkar

title: Fight Club - Members Only (2006) review
claims: The friends find time for songs with 'their respective girlfriends, played by Amrita Arora, Dia Mirza and Neha Dhupia'; no romance is attributed to Shetty.

title: Shaadi Se Pehle Review
claims: Rated 2/5. Anna [Suniel Shetty] is 'Sania's elder goon-brother', who wants Sania and Ashish married without delay; his portions were 'the need of the story' but not imaginatively written; 'Suniel Shetty doesn't impress.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Darna Zaroori Hai Review
claims: Rated 1.5/5. In one story 'A Maharashtrian couple [Suniel, Sonali] have an unexpected visitor in the form of a weird salesman [Rajpal Yadav]', a thief posing as an insurance agent; 'Even Suniel and Rajpal's decent work fail to infuse life.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Chup Chup Ke tries, but fails
claims: Mangal is 'Suniel Shetty doing his over-protective brother routine'; 'The all fists and fury big brother Mangal eventually bows to little sister's wishes.'
author: Sukanya Verma

title: Chup Chup Ke Review
claims: Rated 3.5/5. 'Her over-protective elder brother, Mangal [Suniel Shetty], has fixed her marriage to an affluent businessman in Gujarat'; 'Suniel Shetty is excellent.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Phir Hera Pheri Movie Review
claims: The sequel reunites 'the famous trio -- Raju [Akshay Kumar], Shyam [Suneil Shetty] and Baburao [Paresh Rawal]'; Shyam and Baburao are 'initially reluctant' to invest with the chit-fund scam before giving in; 'a sure-shot paisa-vasool entertainer'.
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Skip Phir Hera Pheri
claims: Shyam is 'a naive innocent born into great debt'; 'Paresh, Akshay and Sunil are decidedly overplaying their roles'; Bipasha Basu and Rimii Sen play 'completely irrelevant characters' and it is 'impossible to understand why our heroes would fall for them'.
author: Raja Sen

title: Watchable, Akshaye ki Khatir
claims: Shirani (Amisha Patel) is to marry Kunal (Sunil Shetty); of Patel: 'Her romantic scenes with a heavily miscast Sunil Shetty make for agonising viewing. It's a how-not-to-act demonstration. In terms of chemistry, none of the actors share any vibes.'
author: Sukanya Verma

title: A more loyal Umrao Jaan
claims: Bollywood's fourth adaptation of the novel; 'Umrao decides to wait for her lover, even as the dacoit Faiz Ali (Sunil Shetty) wants to woo her'; 'Sunil Shetty, Puru Raj Kumar and Ayesha Jhulka don't disappoint either.'
author: Gullu Singh

title: Umrao Jaan (2006) review
claims: With Nawab Sultan unable to pay her price, 'Umrao is sold against her wishes to the highest bidder, Faiz Ali (Suniel Shetty), a notorious bandit in the guise of a Nawab.'

title: Apna Sapna Money Money Review
claims: Rated 2.5/5. Shetty is 'an upright cop' among the ensemble; 'Suniel Shetty is lovable as the honest cop.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Don't Stop Dreaming (2007) review
claims: Calls it 'an unrivalled contender for the worst Brit-Asian film ever made'; Sunil Shetty is billed second in its stars list; his character is not described.

title: Shootout At Lokhandwala Review
claims: Rated 3/5. A top cop [Sanjay Dutt] 'along with Kaviraj Patil [Suniel Shetty] and Javed Shaikh [Arbaaz Khan]' eliminated the gangsters; among standout performances, 'Suniel Shetty [competent]'.
author: Taran Adarsh
notes: Page date (15 May) precedes the 25 May release, presumably a press-show review.

title: Review: Cash isn't worth it
claims: 'Esha Deol, Zayed Khan and Suniel Shetty, of course, are lucky to be cast in anything'; Shamita Shetty 'actually does well'.
author: Raja Sen

title: Cash Review
claims: Rated 2/5. 'The group also faces a threat from underworld don [Suniel Shetty], who is after the same diamonds'; 'Suniel Shetty gets to play a role he has visited a few times in the past.'
author: Taran Adarsh

title: Some decent Kahaaniyan
claims: 'Rise and Fall', the final story, is 'a highly stylised gangster thriller' evoking City of God; 'Highly effective intercutting between the interactions of two youthful shooters with the conflict between adult gangsters played by Suniel Shetty and Sanjay Dutt'.
author: Elvis D'Silva

title: Dus Kahaniyaan Review
claims: Rated 3/5. The Rise and Fall story stars Sanjay Dutt and Suniel Shetty; 'Both Sanju and Suniel are strictly okay.'
author: Taran Adarsh
